objects.summary: Canonical Phase-1 rebuild from immutable base reuses ResearchCampaign injection and produces local adapter/launcher/tests plus manifest/test metadata; local commit exists but claimed PR metadata is not yet proven durable.
Owner independently verifies no remote PR exists for the claimed transport and orders transport-only recovery of the exact local bytes without rebuild.
Codex proves local canonical bytes 7a1154e... are unrecoverable from Git objects, refs, reflogs, filesystem, FDs or retained sessions and refuses prose-based reconstruction.

Owner changes transport law again: final connector response itself must be the complete byte transport artifact, because local PR metadata is ephemeral. Scope is capped at three files and transport must include hashes, manifest, tests, rollback and VM commands.

First successful durable full-byte Phase-1 transport is persisted in Issue #44: all three complete files, exact SHA256s, manifest SHA 9054cd93..., tests, rollback and VM install commands. Claim ceiling remains BUILT_AND_LOCALLY_QUALIFIED_NOT_DEPLOYED and READY_FOR_SCIENCE=NO.
Owner asks only for chunked replay of the already durable transport so the connector can consume it more easily; no rebuild or byte change authorized.
Codex cannot emit multiple issue comments in that environment and correctly refuses to rebuild, alter or truncate the existing transport.
Owner requests exact replay of only tests/test_codex_adapter.py from the durable transport as a byte-memory verification.
Codex exactly replays the test file with original SHA256 8e6fce46..., proving the persisted issue comment can serve as durable byte memory.
Owner requests exact replay of the transport manifest/tail only, again forbidding regeneration.
Codex replays exact manifest SHA 9054cd93..., test results, rollback and VM commands, preserving original byte identities and claim ceiling.

Owner begins independent adversarial review of exact remote candidate d1dcace... materialized from the durable transport, challenging authority enforcement, reviewer independence, causal/replay races, scheduler liveness, hidden authority and missing counterexamples.

Independent review classifies all six requested dimensions DEFECT: free-form prompt authority is not machine fenced; same-bot review is not independence; replay/TOCTOU/ref ancestry and comment-asserted CI/review are insufficient; blocking flock can queue stale wakes; hidden delegated authority remains possible; material counterexamples are untested.

Owner orders minimal repair on the same remote branch/PR #46, not a rebuild: structured AuthorityEnvelope, builder/reviewer causal separation, remote ledger and generation fencing, nonblocking one-tick liveness, expanded adversarial tests and canonical status projection refresh.

Owner starts review-only challenge on repaired exact head 3c779549..., requiring explicit separation of CODE_PRESENT/TESTED/HOSTED_QUALIFIED/INDEPENDENTLY_REVIEWED/DEPLOYED/E2E_PROVEN and no code modification.
Codex review summary later records completed review with unresolved findings on newer commit 768eaa77..., proving the exact subject moved and the prior 3c779549 review subject became stale.
Owner separately requests security review on 3c779549; this request later becomes stale as head advances.
Owner reissues review-only request on newer exact subject ea454e6..., specifically including the machine-policy fence and post-review-request causal PASS requirement.
Owner reissues security review on exact ea454e6..., focusing on marker trust, actor binding, model-output fences, review causality, replay/races, credential scope and science/economic isolation.

Owner freezes final Phase-1 review subject at 768eaa77... and requires retesting four decisive counterexamples: forbidden CONTINUE, pre-seeded PASS, actor mismatch before POST and launcher scientific-queue isolation.

cross_object_findings.finding: Persisting complete exact bytes in the connector final response finally survives worker destruction; later exact replays prove issue comments can function as durable engineering memory when remote branch publication is unavailable.
Multiple builds claimed PR metadata locally but no remote PR existed. The transport mechanism itself had to be changed from local metadata to remotely persisted connector output.

The first exact remote candidate was not merely missing polish: all six security/control dimensions were falsified, including machine authority, review independence, replay/TOCTOU, liveness and hidden delegated authority. The repair pass was therefore materially necessary.

Once a durable remote candidate existed, Owner correctly required minimal repair on the same branch rather than another implementation lineage, reducing restart cost and preserving evidence continuity.
Repair heads moved from d1dcace to 3c779549 to ea454e6 and finally 768eaa77. Review requests on superseded heads were explicitly marked stale; no old review may qualify a newer subject.

Hosted run 41128393667 failed only because STATE.md test-count projection was stale (371 vs 377), not because the adapter semantics failed. Projection freshness must be repaired without misclassifying product behavior.
